subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 new action revisions together across secret-bearing, release, scanning, and agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but approving newly pinned third-party executable code in protected security-sensitive workflows requires owner intent beyond ordinary CI.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Merge the grouped update after required checks finish and the workflow owner confirms the secret-bearing action revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate token, registry, Codex, and CodeQL action bumps from routine setup-action bumps for narrower validation and rollback.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Retain the existing pins until representative manual and release workflows can be exercised safely.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Merge the grouped update after required checks finish and the workflow owner confirms the secret-bearing action revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best-supported repository and release-workflow decision owner in the available history.
